// default_engine: Model picker / CLI default when none specified. Prefer parakeet for English live; use sensevoice for Cantonese.
// parakeet_feed_sec: Audio seconds fed to Parakeet per add_audio (~0.3–0.5). Lower = snappier drafts, more thrash.
// post_final_cooldown_sec: Seconds to discard mic audio after each committed final (cuts self-echo / reprint). Shared by live engines.
// mic_blocksize: sounddevice frames per callback at 16 kHz (~3200–4096 cuts Python wakeups; keep latency reasonable).
// vad_min_rms: Minimum mic energy (0–1) treated as speech. Higher = less sensitive to ambient / bleed.
// min_final_chars: Prefer not emitting tiny Parakeet finals shorter than this unless the delta ends in punctuation. Latency still wins over perfect segmentation.
